newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Feb wheat imports down 74.6 pct - paper.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Feb wheat imports down 74.6 pct - paper.

text.p: China imported 270,000 tonnes of wheat in January to February 1997, down 74.6 percent from the year-ago period, the Futures Herald said in an edition seen in Beijing on Saturday.
China imported 110,000 tonnes of wheat in February alone, the newspaper's March 20 edition quoted customs statistics as saying.
China's corn exports totalled 70,000 tonnes in the first two months, with 60,000 tonnes exported in February alone, it said but gave no further details.
Official customs figures show China exported 20,000 tonnes of corn in January but the newspaper did not explain the discrepancy.
Exports of edible oilseeds were 80,000 tonnes in January-February, down 52.1 percent from the year-ago period, with exports in February alone reaching 40,000 tonnes, it said.
